control_point: inspection metrology yield management and installed service
burden_carrier: engineering/R&D, service labor, inventory, suppliers, customer credit, export controls, debt, and dilution
denominator: cycle-normalized OCF less PP&E and economic maintenance/support claims after factoring, commitments, debt, SBC, and common-owner claims
decisive_breaker: revenue and adjusted earnings rise while factoring, working capital, commitments, R&D, or capital returns weaken diluted common-owner cash
